Train Enhanced Sliced Wasserstein Autoencoder (SWAE) with Annealing

Source: R/MMD_Vae.R
trainSWAEEnhanced.Rd

Trains an autoencoder with Sliced Wasserstein Distance regularization using a custom training loop that supports lambda annealing. This version offers better control over training dynamics and typically produces better latent representations than the standard SWAE.

Usage

trainSWAEEnhanced(
  trainData,
  useMarkers,
  epochs = 100L,
  latentDim = 32L,
  lambda = 10,
  lambdaAnnealEpochs = 0L,
  numProjections = 100L,
  batchSize = 256L,
  learningRate = 0.001,
  hiddenDims = c(256L, 128L),
  valData = NULL,
  verbose = 10L,
  seed = 1994
)

Arguments

trainData

Data frame or matrix of training data.

useMarkers

Character vector; names of marker columns to use.

epochs

Integer; number of training epochs, default is 100.

latentDim

Integer; dimensionality of latent space. Default is 32.

lambda

Numeric; final regularization weight for SW loss, default is 10.0.

lambdaAnnealEpochs

Integer; epochs to linearly anneal lambda from 0 to final value. Default is 0 (no annealing). Recommended: 20-50 epochs for better representations.

numProjections

Integer; number of random projections for SW distance, default is 100L.

batchSize

Integer; batch size for training, default is 256.

learningRate

Numeric; learning rate, default is 1e-3.

hiddenDims

Integer vector; sizes of hidden layers. Default is c(256, 128).

valData

Optional validation data for monitoring.

verbose

Integer; print frequency. Default is 10 (every 10 epochs).

seed

Integer; random seed for reproducibility, default is 1994.

Value

List containing encoder, decoder, and training history.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Train enhanced SWAE with lambda annealing
swae_model <- trainSWAEEnhanced(
  trainData = train_data,
  useMarkers = markers,
  epochs = 100,
  latentDim = 32,
  lambda = 10.0,
  lambdaAnnealEpochs = 30,  # Anneal over first 30 epochs
  hiddenDims = c(256, 128),
  batchSize = 256,
  seed = 1994
)

# Get latent representations
latent <- encodeSWAE(swae_model, new_data)
} # }
